selected_script.angle: Low-cabinet organizing and floor-level chores posture improvement
selected_script.hook: Crouching down on your knees to clean or organize low cabinets is absolute torture for your joints.

usage_steps_used: Sit down softly on the seat cushion with back against the curved backrest.
Glide across smooth indoor flooring using feet to push, allowing wheels to roll.

script_record.0-3s: Show an adult home user awkwardly crouching on their knees on a hard kitchen floor, straining to reach items in a deep low cabinet.
script_record.3-6s: The user sits down softly on the low-profile rolling backrest chair, instantly resolving their uncomfortable posture.
script_record.6-10s: The user sits comfortably in an upright low seated position, organizing the shelf with ease.
script_record.10-14s: The user uses their feet to push and glide smoothly across the kitchen floor to reach another cabinet.
script_record.14-18s: Close-up shot of the noiseless caster wheels spinning 360 degrees as the stool rolls.
script_record.18-20s: The stool sits next to a beautifully organized low cabinet, text overlay: 'Glide through your chores in comfort.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in 9:16 realistic handheld phone-shot style. 0-3s: Show an adult home user awkwardly crouching on their knees on a hard kitchen floor, straining to organize a deep low cabinet, capturing their discomfort. 3-6s: Introduce the low-profile rolling backrest chair from the reference image, featuring a dark grey plush seat and backrest, and an off-white tubular metal frame. The user sits down softly on the seat cushion. 6-10s: First fast-cut scene showing the user sitting comfortably in an upright low seated position. Keep the pacing fast, clear, and product-focused. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not include any text overlays or CTA. Preserve exact product color, shape, materials, and size ratio.
